verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a first-party migration guide for version 5.0.0 of the Stripe Terminal SDK. That shows the SDK uses major versions and ships documented migration paths. Nothing in the pack describes API-level versioning or a published deprecation or support-lifecycle policy. Missing for 10: documented API versioning scheme, documented deprecation/sunset policy and timelines, SDK support-lifecycle commitments, independent corroboration.
